title: Electrochemical N2 reduction (NRR) reference family
reaction: N2 + 6 H+ + 6 e- -> 2 NH3 (aqueous) | Li + N2 + e- -> Li3N -> NH3 (lithium-mediated cycle)
objective: Optional literature-backed family for electrochemical ammonia synthesis. Candidates compare a lithium-mediated NRR cathode (the most rigorously validated route to date), a plasma-assisted NRR option, and an ambient aqueous Cu / Bi cathode anchor. Note: ambient aqueous NRR claims require strict isotope and contamination controls (Andersen 2019, Choi 2020); the aqueous candidate here is a literature-architecture proxy, not an industrial benchmark.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Balance current stack economics, evidence quality, route maturity, and reported NH3-production performance.

cost-first.label: Cost-first
cost-first.description: Bias ranking toward catalyst and electrode cost while preserving route and evidence guardrails.

evidence-first.label: Evidence-first
evidence-first.description: Reward stronger literature support and rigorous (isotope-verified) NH3 production claims.

citations.label: Nature 2019
citations.note: Andersen, Colic et al.: rigorous electrochemical ammonia synthesis protocol with quantitative isotope measurements; reset benchmark for genuine NRR claims and exposed widespread contamination artefacts.

citations.label: Nature Catalysis 2019
citations.note: Suryanto, Du et al.: comprehensive review of challenges and prospects in electroreduction of nitrogen to ammonia, organising aqueous, non-aqueous, and lithium-mediated routes.

citations.label: Nature Communications 2020
citations.note: Choi, Suryanto et al.: identification and elimination of false positives in electrochemical NRR studies, establishing community-standard isotope and blank protocols.

citations.label: Joule 2019
citations.note: Lazouski, Schiffer et al.: understanding continuous lithium-mediated electrochemical nitrogen reduction, foundational study of the most reproducible NRR mechanism.

citations.label: Science 2019
citations.note: De Luna, Hahn et al.: what would it take for renewably powered electrosynthesis to displace petrochemical processes; key techno-economic framing for green NH3.

citations.label: ACS Sustainable Chem. Eng. 2020
citations.note: Gorbanev, Vervloessem et al.: nitrogen fixation with water vapor by non-equilibrium plasma toward sustainable ammonia production, demonstrating an alternative non-electrochemical N2 fixation route.

citations.label: Joule 2023
citations.note: Hou, Deng et al.: membrane electrode assembly for lithium-mediated nitrogen reduction, mapping the technical roadmap from batch to continuous flow operation.

route_templates.name: Lithium-mediated NRR cathode route
synthesis: Cathode coating with Li-cycle compatible binder
postprocess: Substrate pretreatment for Li plating cycle
Hot-press / cell assembly under inert atmosphere
quality_gates: Faradaic efficiency to NH3 with isotope verification
Long-hold stability under N2 / H2 feed
route_templates.route_note: Most rigorously validated NRR mechanism; engineering complexity comes from inert-atmosphere handling and Li-cycle reproducibility.

route_templates.name: Plasma-NRR cathode route
route_templates.route_note: Plasma-assisted N2 fixation provides a non-electrochemical NH3 route with demonstrable production at the cost of high plasma energy input.

route_templates.name: Aqueous Cu / Bi NRR cathode route
preprocess: Conductive carbon support and GDL preparation
route_templates.route_note: Aqueous NRR research-stage proxy; literature-architecture only — many ambient NRR claims have failed isotope and blank controls (Choi 2020), so this route should be treated as a screening anchor, not a process basis.

candidates.title: Lithium-mediated NRR cathode
candidates.summary: Non-aqueous lithium-mediated NRR using a Cu or steel cathode in a THF / Li salt electrolyte; the most rigorously demonstrated electrochemical NH3-production route.
decision_notes: Best fit when rigorous, reproducible NH3 production matters more than aqueous simplicity.
Cost is dominated by THF / Li salt cycle and inert-atmosphere stack hardware rather than catalyst material.

pricing.note: Live Cu feed with a precursor / conversion markup for the lithium-cycle cathode current collector.

candidates.title: Plasma-NRR ammonia route
candidates.summary: Plasma-assisted N2 fixation with an aqueous trap, producing NH3 / HNO3 mixtures recoverable as ammonium salts.
decision_notes: Use when a non-electrochemical pathway is acceptable and plasma equipment is available.
Energy efficiency remains the main bottleneck; trap-side recovery design dominates cost.

pricing.note: Live Ni feed with a precursor / conversion markup for plasma-tolerant cathode screening.

candidates.title: Aqueous NRR research anchor (Cu)
candidates.summary: Cu-based aqueous NRR cathode used as a literature-architecture screening anchor; ambient aqueous NRR claims require isotope and blank controls per Choi 2020.
decision_notes: Use this only as a screening anchor; ambient aqueous NRR claims have a high false-positive rate without 15N2 isotope verification.
If the program target is real NH3 production, prefer the lithium-mediated or plasma routes above.

pricing.note: Live Cu feed with a precursor / conversion markup for aqueous research-stage cathode screening.
